posts.description: Kira began as a tool for making beautiful things: turn a photo or a prompt into portraits, cinematic shots, videos. Now it's a place to share them, too. Kira Community is where your creations become moments. Tag your work with #hashtags, keep it on your profile, and browse a feed built around the themes people actually care about; and the people who care about them with you. This is Kira's first step from a tool to a community. Curate your moments, and share them with people who get it.

posts.name: PaisaSync
posts.tagline: Private UPI & bank SMS expense tracking, made for India
posts.description: PaisaSync automatically turns bank and UPI SMS alerts into clear expense tracking and budgets. Your financial data stays on your phone—no bank login, account connection, or cloud sync required. Built for people in India who want a simple, private view of where their money goes.

posts.name: RawY2K: 90s & Y2K Retro Theme
posts.tagline: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme.
posts.description: RawY2K is the ultimate retro modifier that transforms any modern webpage into a vintage 90s and Y2K aesthetic experience. Customize your browser instantly with 12+ custom cursors, nostalgic Windows 98 UI, classic GeoCities themes, CRT scanlines, and animated starfields. Enjoy a built-in MIDI chiptune synth, sparkle trails, marquee banners, and classic popup ads. Fully customizable - turn the whole theme on or pick specific retro elements. Bring back the golden age of the raw, fun internet!

posts.name: Neoswarm
posts.tagline: Neovim for controlling ai agents at 10x productivity
posts.description: A terminal alternative for controlling ai agents at scale inspired by neovim. Minimal, stylish ui with good keybindings so you never have to touch the mouse again. Fully configurable and extendable with plugins. Supports every major cli, use it with your own AI plans. Replacement for paseo, conductor, paseo and every other GUI tools.

posts.name: FixMyResume
posts.tagline: Tailor your resume to any job in seconds using AI
posts.description: Most AI resume builders force you through tedious wizards. FixMyResume cuts out the noise with a frictionless tool built for speed. Just paste your base resume, the job description, and optional fine-tuning instructions if you want to highlight specific skills. Hit generate to instantly get a perfectly tailored, ATS-friendly resume and matching cover letter in seconds. No monthly subscriptions, just a pay-as-you-go credit system to get you interview-ready instantly.

posts.name: SnapPrice
posts.tagline: Snap it. Price it. List it.
posts.description: Snap a photo of a thrift or reseller find. SnapPrice pulls eBay sold comps, runs fee math so you see take-home, and drafts a listing you can copy over. One free lifetime scan, one listing draft, two optimizer scans. Pro is $2.99/month. No signup required.

posts.name: Werewolf Club
posts.tagline: Live video Werewolf where everyone gets to play
posts.description: Play a complete game of Werewolf with 4 to 16 friends on live video. The moderator built into the game deals the roles, runs each night and reveals the verdicts, so nobody sits out. Players join free from one browser link. No app is needed.

posts.name: RevQA — intelligence for outbound teams
posts.tagline: Account intelligence for outbound teams such as BDR/SDR & AE
posts.description: RevQA researches every account before your team picks up the phone — buying signals, the org chart, a pre-call brief, even a drafted cadence.

posts.name: Devirto: Data Exploration Virtual Tool
posts.tagline: Explore your data. No code required.
posts.description: Devirto is a no-code data exploration tool that turns CSV files into automated EDA. Upload a dataset to detect column types, data quality issues, feature relationships and relevance, and generate statistical insights. Test your own hypotheses, filter problematic data, download cleaned datasets, and build custom PDF reports. No setup, no code, and currently no sign-up required. Devirto is free to use while I test it with real-world datasets.

posts.name: Chessy
posts.tagline: Your games, your chess coach
posts.description: Chessy connects to your Chess.com or Lichess account and turns your real games into a training plan — puzzles from your actual blunders, a weekly coaching report, and an AI coach that knows your patterns. Not generic advice. Built from how you actually play.

posts.name: Patlas
posts.tagline: Scan your code or ask AI — real patent prior-art search
posts.description: Patlas is an MCP server giving your AI agent real prior-art patent search. Ask an idea in plain English, or point the free patent-scan skill at your own codebase to surface mechanisms worth checking — even ones you never thought to search for. Every result is validated against the real retrieved patent text before it's shown: no invented patent IDs, no fabricated quotes. Not legal advice — a fast, honest first signal before you talk to an attorney.

posts.name: Tablekard
posts.tagline: Powering Smarter Restaurants
posts.description: Tablekard connects diners, kitchens, staff, and restaurant owners through QR ordering, real-time queues, online payments, geofencing, and restaurant management tools.

posts.name: Gets.me - Free AI Agent inside Telegram
posts.tagline: AI + Takeover: Set goals in chats - gets.me agent takes over
posts.description: Free! I got the tokens so let's burn em. No account. So Sign up. No Payment. You can't even pay if you wanted because Stripe isn't connected. Takeover is the best feature - inside a conversation @getsme to add to the chat... then /takeover and set a goal and the agent will work towards that until it is complete... Text/Voice/Image etc... Try Takeover! Chat, remember, create, plan, schedule reminders and manage selected one-to-one replies with Gets.me inside Telegram.

posts.name: Scran
posts.tagline: Take the mental load out of cooking
posts.description: Scran is a mobile app that makes cooking easier and more accessible for neurodivergent cooks. Bring recipes from anywhere into a visual library, then simplify them into manageable tasks with prep upfront and ingredient amounts where you need them. Spend less energy following the recipe and more time enjoying the cooking.

posts.name: BracketEngine
posts.tagline: Free Tournament Bracket Generator
posts.description: Create, customize, and print tournament brackets for March Madness, pickleball, soccer, tennis, and esports. 100% free, 4-64 teams, live score tracking & PDF printables.

posts.name: IQ Routing
posts.tagline: Trajectory-aware LLM routing that cuts agent cost
posts.description: IQ Routing is a drop-in gateway. We classify each request, serve from cache, and route to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar and completes the task. The insight others miss: an agent is a trajectory, not a stream of independent calls. We route each step based on where it sits in the run: a cheap model on boilerplate, the strongest model on what matters.

posts.name: Niche Sports
posts.tagline: Your niche, mapped.
posts.description: Niche offers an interactive map showing pre-defined spots where you can practice different outdoor sports — surfing, climbing, and soon skiing/snowboarding. Each spot displays weather forecast data relevant to that sport, along with a status prediction based on current conditions. Currently in beta, Niche is only available in Romania, but more countries will be added soon. The plan is to open-source the spots data so others can correct existing spots or add new ones.

posts.name: Pluto
posts.tagline: Your professional profile is now an AI agent
posts.description: Pluto is an AI voice agent that learns your story in 10 minutes and makes you discoverable to the right people and AI agents. Most profiles reduce you to titles and keywords. Pluto learns what they miss, from what you are great at to what you want next and how you work best. It turns that understanding into a living professional profile that stays current as you do and represents the fuller picture of who you are.

posts.name: In Bird Years
posts.tagline: How old would you be, as a bird?
posts.description: So at 34 you are a great tit on its second spring, holding a nest hole and a two-note song the whole street knows by heart. The same 34 makes you a raven on its sixth spring with a partner for life, and a yellow-tailed black-cockatoo still being fussed over by its parents. Age, it turns out, depends a lot on the wings.

posts.name: llmbytes
posts.tagline: Daily AI news, researched and written — not a scraped feed
posts.description: Most AI news apps are an RSS feed with a skin. llmbytes researches each story from the original sources, writes it, and links every source under the article. Up to eight items a day, no fixed quota — a quiet day gets four rather than eight padded ones. FIRSTS — every year since 1956 and what AI learned in it, each entry sourced. MODELS — price per million tokens, context window and capabilities for the current models, refreshed weekly, stamped with the date. No account. Works offline. Free.

posts.name: Cam PDF Scanner: Sign & OCR
posts.tagline: Scan, sign and export clean PDFs without an added watermark
posts.description: Turn camera scans or gallery images into clean PDFs without an app-added watermark. Cam PDF Scanner combines multi-page scanning, OCR, signatures, front-and-back ID copies, image and ZIP exports, and QR tools in one Android app. It is free to use, supported by ads, requires an account, and includes a weekly export allowance with rewarded-ad recovery when available.
